title: prerequisite to launch your first affiliate campaign
text:
Before you can launch your first affiliate campaign, make sure to complete the following steps:
Enable Stripe Connect : Set up Stripe Connect for payments (Go to Settings > Integrations > Stripe Connect).  [https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48000981400-stripe-integration] Learn more here.
List Your Products: Products can be listed in the following areas:
Funnels:  [https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001204219] Guide to adding products to funnels.
Website:  [https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001204219] Learn how to add products to your website.
Online Stores:  [https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000001157-how-to-set-up-an-e-commerce-online-store-websites-] Set up an online store.
Track Leads : Use Forms, Surveys, or Calendars to track leads that your affiliates generate.
Connect PayPal Business : For quick and easy affiliate payouts, link your PayPal Business account. Learn more here.
